adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new loop `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` contains an `else` branch for destinations without `credentialId` that does `this.calendarCredentials.filter((c) => c.type === destination.integration)` and then creates events for *all* matching credentials. Because this branch now executes once per destination entry, multiple destinationCalendar entries with the same `integration` and no `credentialId` will re-run the same credential set multiple times, producing duplicate created events. Previously, with a single `destinationCalendar` object, this logic could only run once per booking/event.
